mapper.insert: insert ignore into seckill_order_outbox( message_id, route_key, topic, message_body, status, retry_count, next_retry_time, error_message, trace_id, create_time, update_time ) values( #{messageId}, #{routeKey}, #{topic}, #{messageBody}, #{status}, #{retryCount}, #{nextRetryTime}, #{errorMessage}, #{traceId}, now(), now() )
mapper.select: select id, message_id, route_key, topic, message_body, status, retry_count, next_retry_time, error_message, trace_id, create_time, update_time from seckill_order_outbox where message_id = #{messageId}
mapper.update: update seckill_order_outbox set status = 1, error_message = null, next_retry_time = null, update_time = now() where message_id = #{messageId}
mapper.select: select id, message_id, route_key, topic, message_body, status, retry_count, next_retry_time, error_message, trace_id, create_time, update_time from seckill_order_outbox where status in (0, 2) and (next_retry_time is null or next_retry_time <= now()) order by id asc limit #{limit}

select id, message_id, route_key, topic, message_body, status, retry_count, next_retry_time, error_message, trace_id, create_time, update_time from seckill_order_outbox where status in (0, 2, 3) order by update_time asc, id asc limit #{limit}
